caption: : Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation.
model_annotation: The figure is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating the average rate (as percentages) at which a model’s attention is highest on each of three input segments during generation, comparing two methods labeled “Ours” and “Standard.” The category axis is vertical (y-axis) with two categories ordered top-to-bottom as “Ours” then “Standard.” The value axis is horizontal (x-axis) and represents proportions in percent across a 0–100% span (not explicitly tick-labeled in the image), with each bar filling the full width as a 100% stack. Each category is shown as a single bar subdivided into three colored segments corresponding to the legend: “Context” in blue, “Generated Response” in orange, and “Other” in green. For “Ours,” the stacked segments are labeled 60.6% (blue Context), 31.7% (orange Generated Response), and 7.7% (green Other). For “Standard,” the segments are labeled 23.6% (blue Context), 51.1% (orange Generated Response), and 25.3% (green Other). The chart uses stacked composition rather than grouped bars, with segment boundaries clearly separated and percentage annotations centered within each colored segment; there is no additional visual emphasis such as outlines or callouts beyond the in-bar labels and the legend placed below the plot.
